reuse.why: Calls the shared getRangeExpectedAmount but ignores getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which already decides the missing, numeric and ranged cases in one call.

duplication.why: The missing ? 0 : number ? amount : range dispatch in toExternal restates the body of getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: Deriving an API field in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts fits the tree's API mapping layer; the rule itself correctly stays in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the API model, its handler type, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: If the expected-amount rule changes in getScheduledAmount this API copy of the dispatch will not follow, and toExternal now returns a 'list' type for every caller of the model.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts re-does the dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount).

disguised_duplication.where: The nested ternary in toExternal is getScheduledAmount's if/typeof/getRangeExpectedAmount sequence reshaped into an expression.
